code_blocks.code:
Offline content QA board

Search Snippet Proof Board

Paste a title tag, meta description, search-result promise, and supporting notes. The board splits the snippet into claims, checks each against the notes, flags risky wording, and exports a rewrite brief.

Snippet inputs

Use the actual title tag, not the working headline.

Paste article notes, source excerpts, evidence bullets, or what the page truly contains.

Evidence score

0 backed score
0 claims audited
0 unsupported or risky
0% average evidence match
0 risk flags

Claim cards

Rewrite brief

The brief updates whenever claim statuses or notes change.

Runs locally in one HTML file. No external libraries, assets, APIs, tracking, or network calls.
